title: Stalk criterion
statement: Let S be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], H a sheaf of sets on its small étale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] with monic map to the terminal sheaf, and W an open with the section factorization and emptiness property of [lem-weil-pbc-etale-subsheaf-final-open-parts-factorization]. For every geometric point x : Spec Ω → S [def-weil-geometric-point], its image point lies in W if and only if the geometric stalk of H at x [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] is nonempty. Nonemptiness of this stalk is equivalent to it being a singleton.

proof.text: Represent a stalk element by a section over a pointed étale neighbourhood. The factorization property of W puts the image point in W. Conversely x in W lifts through its open immersion; W with this lift is a pointed étale neighbourhood, and the identity factorization yields a unique section whose image gives a stalk element.

Monicity into the terminal sheaf makes every section set a subsingleton. Any two stalk representatives become comparable in a common pointed refinement and their restrictions agree by subsingletonness, so the filtered colimit is a subsingleton. A nonempty subsingleton admits a Unique structure, and a Unique structure supplies an element.

lean.statement:
theorem etale_subsheaf_final_stalk_criterion (S : Scheme.{u})
    (H : Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology (Type (max u v)))
    [Mono (terminal.from H)] (W : S.Opens)
    (hW : etaleSubsheafFactorization S H W) :
    ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (x : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S),
      (x default ∈ W ↔ Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj H)) ∧
      (Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj H) ↔
        Nonempty (Unique ((pointSmallEtale x).sheafFiber.obj H)))
